title: Technology Sector Update for 12/03/2018: NOK,IQ,QCOM,NXPI - Nasdaq.com
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT +0.80%
AAPL +2.20%
IBM +0.50%
CSCO +1.21%
GOOG +1.83%
Technology stocks were firming in recent trading, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding 1.4% in value, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising 2.5%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Nokia ( NOK ) was posting a more than 2% advance in recent Monday trading after announcing a EUR250 million loan transaction with the Nordic Investment Bank to fund 5G-technology research and development. The loan has an average maturity of about 5 years following disbursement and will particularly focus on developing new 5G-related product offerings for varied business areas.
In other sector news:
(+) Iqiyi ( IQ ) was more than 2% unveiling the world's first virtual AI/AR sign language interpreter for its video content.
(+) Qualcomm ( QCOM ) has given up most of its earlier advance after the company told Reuters it wasn't planning to revive a proposed takeover of NXP Semiconductors ( NXPI ).
